concept: Review and integration: what taking care of your body and moving it feels like so far
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Of moving your body, practicing a skill, and resting/eating well — which do you want to do more of?
exercise.practice: Student summarizes, in their own words, what 'physical excellence' means so far

assessment.success_marker: student offers a personal definition connecting to at least one prior story
